title: The Adventures of Robin Hood
subtitle: The Cooperative Living Storybook Campaign
tagline: Roam freely through Sherwood Forest and Nottingham across a living, gridless storybook board.
loreSummary: You are Robin Hood, Maid Marian, Little John, and Will Scarlet fighting for freedom in 12th-century England. Moving freely across a seamless living gameboard without hexes or grids, you will turn over hidden cardboard inserts, consult a premium hardcover storybook, evade the Sheriff's patrols, and champion the oppressed.
keyFeatures: Innovative gridless movement using wooden connecting pieces directly on the board
Living, evolving gameboard with double-sided removable tiles revealing hidden secrets
Branching hardcover storybook guiding dynamic story events and multiple endings
Zero setup time with rules taught organically through introductory chapters

robin_hood_full_chronicle.name: Full 9-Chapter Chronicle
robin_hood_full_chronicle.description: The complete 9-chapter cooperative storybook saga from the initial outlawing to King Richard's return.

robin_hood_act_one.name: Act 1: Sherwood Outlaws (Chapters 1–4)
robin_hood_act_one.description: Play the first 4 chapters assembling the Merry Men, learning gridless movement, and mounting early rescue raids.

robin_hood_master_outlaws.name: Master Outlaws & Alternate Paths (13 Chapters)
robin_hood_master_outlaws.description: The full 9-chapter story plus 4 branching alternate paths and hard-mode variant missions.

milestones.title: Outlaws of Sherwood
milestones.description: Evade the Sheriff's patrols, find refuge deep in Sherwood Forest, and rally Little John and Maid Marian.

milestones.title: Infiltration of Nottingham Castle
milestones.description: Sneak into Nottingham Castle, flip secret board tiles, and liberate captured allies from the dungeons.

milestones.title: The Sheriff's Retaliation
milestones.description: Defend the peasant villages, outmaneuver armored knight columns, and strike a decisive blow against Guy of Gisborne.

milestones.title: The Return of the King
milestones.description: Storm the castle, overthrow the corrupt regency, and welcome King Richard the Lionheart back to England.
